# Prime Carpet Cleaning and Upholstery Steam Cleaning

> Professional carpet, upholstery, rug and mattress cleaning for homes, offices and commercial spaces in London, Berkshire, Surrey and Hampshire. Fixed, transparent quotes with no hidden fees; booking by phone, WhatsApp or the quote form.

## Services

- [Carpet Cleaning](https://primecarpetcleaning.co.uk/services/carpet-cleaning/): Deep carpet cleaning using professional extraction equipment.
- [Upholstery & Sofa Cleaning](https://primecarpetcleaning.co.uk/services/upholstery-sofa-cleaning/): Fabric-safe cleaning for sofas, armchairs and office seating.
- [Rug Cleaning](https://primecarpetcleaning.co.uk/services/rug-cleaning/): Careful cleaning for everyday and delicate rugs.
- [Mattress Cleaning](https://primecarpetcleaning.co.uk/services/mattress-cleaning/): Removes dust, allergens and odours from mattresses.
- [Stain Removal](https://primecarpetcleaning.co.uk/services/stain-removal/): Treatment for wine, coffee, mud, food and pet accidents.
- [End-of-Tenancy Cleaning](https://primecarpetcleaning.co.uk/services/end-of-tenancy-cleaning/): Carpet and upholstery cleaning before handing back a rental property.
